{/* ABOUT */}
About I am a researcher at École Polytechnique and Inria Saclay, working on generative modeling for discrete scientific structures including molecular graphs and symbolic biological systems. With Sanofi, I develop aligned, domain-adapted LLMs for pharmacological reasoning.
{/* VISION */}
Research Vision My long-term goal is to build autonomous scientific agents capable of proposing experiments, refining molecular candidates, and interacting with scientific literature via tool-use and retrieval-augmented reasoning.
{/* TIMELINE */}
Experience Timeline
  • 2025–Present: École Polytechnique & Inria Saclay — Discrete generative modeling (diffusion, flow matching).
  • 2024–2025: Sanofi — LLM finetuning and alignment for drug development.
  • 2023–2024: Retail analytics — shape-based demand modeling with DTW/DBA.
